Dispensary Near I-94 Exit 1 (New Buffalo) — Quick, Easy Pickup

Minutes from the M-239 exit with easy access from US-12 for Indiana + Chicago traffic headed into Harbor Country.

Directions & Parking

  1. Getting here from I-94 Exit 1 (M-239 / New Buffalo)

    1. Take I-94 Exit 1 toward New Buffalo / M-239.
    2. Follow M-239 toward New Buffalo.
    3. Connect to US-12 and continue to 19189 US-12 (High Society New Buffalo).

    Get Directions

  2. Getting here from US-12 (New Buffalo travel corridor)

    1. Stay on US-12 through the New Buffalo corridor.
    2. Look for High Society at 19189 US-12 (easy pull-in parking).

    Get Directions

  3. Parking

    Parking Notes: Free on-site parking makes this a true highway stop - quick in/out for I-94 travelers and US-12 commuters.

Fast Pickup, Friendly Team

Walk in, get checked in, and head to the counter. Most visits take under 10 minutes. Our team can point you to popular categories and answer questions. We accept cash and debit; ATMs are available on site. The store and parking are accessible.

For I-94 + US-12 travelers

  • Easy stop for Chicago / Indiana traffic heading into Michigan

  • Quick detour off Exit 1 (M-239) before you hit the lake towns

  • Great for weekend trips—check today’s hours above

Crossing state lines

Heading home? Enjoy responsibly in Michigan and don’t travel across state lines with cannabis. Read our Illinois and Indiana law guides before you go.

FAQ

Do you have parking?

Yes—free on-site parking.

What ID do I need?

Valid government-issued photo ID; 21+ only.

Do you take cards?

Debit is accepted; cash is welcome.

Can I use an out-of-state ID (IN/IL)?

Yes—valid government-issued ID works (must be 21+).

How long does pickup take?

Most visits are quick — ideal for highway travelers.

Holiday hours?

We post updates on this page and on our Google listing (you can call to be sure).
